## Scope

- Keep YouTube as the video host and keep embedded playback in the Lead Lab application.
- Let an administrator paste either a YouTube URL or a complete YouTube iframe embed code into the existing session form.
- Normalize the input server-side and store only a canonical YouTube watch URL.
- Generate a privacy-enhanced embed with reduced native controls and an accessible application-owned control bar.
- Keep application authentication, active-user checks, and published-session checks as the access boundary.
- Record the remaining limitation that an authenticated participant can inspect the browser and recover the YouTube video ID.

## Out Of Scope

- YouTube API or OAuth integration for changing video privacy settings.
- Private video hosting, application video proxying, signed media URLs, or a new streaming service.
- A claim that YouTube embed URLs can remain secret from an authenticated participant.
- Staging, production deployment, or final launch acceptance.
